headline: Queens spread nine goals across seven scorers
dek: No other programme in the conference has scored as often or through as many players. The win at East Stroudsburg was Queens' second, set against one defeat, at Holy Family, and a draw with Southern New Hampshire.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Staten Island's six goals are level with Mercy's and have bought only one win: seven conceded outweigh them, and this chart ranks attacks only.

wire.line: Mercy have lost only on opening day and conceded three goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd and Molloy's at Caldwell. There are no score gaps.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jacob Darwesh Lund-Iversen has scored three of Mercy's six goals, from eight shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded eight goals, more than any other programme, and are still without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: D'Youville's two clean sheets, both Matthew Solorio's, were both goalless draws: the side has drawn twice, lost twice, and is still without a win.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lorenzo Herrera has made 21 saves for District of Columbia, and all four goals past him came at Slippery Rock.

last_match.line: Mercy's second clean sheet in a row after the goalless draw at Adelphi; Bridgeport host Queens on Wednesday.

next_match.line: Molloy have a win at Saint Anselm and a defeat by Assumption, with their match at Caldwell still without a result; Holy Family beat Queens six days earlier.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
